description: Manage the user's supplement stack. Local: action="list" returns the local stack (slugs + any dosage/timing/brand); "add"/"remove" with a slug edit it — `add` also accepts dose, timing, and brand. Cloud (requires the user to be logged in): "pull" overwrites the local stack from their account, "push" overwrites their account from local, "sync" merges both (union) and saves to both — all preserving per-supplement dosage/timing/brand. Slugs are SupStack supplement ids (e.g. magnesium).
name: supstack_stack
